authority: Cambridge International AS & A Level Computer Science 9618 syllabus, 2027-2029, Version 2

records.resolution: Adds visible CORE teaching, worked application, practice and two assessment forms for the distinct needs for input, output, primary memory, secondary storage and removable storage.
Defines embedded systems by dedicated purpose inside a larger device and assesses contextual benefits and drawbacks rather than size alone.
Teaches and directly assesses the principal operation of all nine named hardware categories across L029, L030 and L032.
Explains buffers as temporary rate-matching storage and rejects the permanent-backup and printer-speed misconceptions.
Distinguishes RAM and ROM by volatility, purpose and system use in teaching, practice and assessment.
Connects SRAM and DRAM mechanisms and trade-offs to cache and main-memory choices, with quiz and review evidence.
Separates one-time PROM, ultraviolet-erased EPROM and electrically rewritten EEPROM in both teaching and direct assessment.
Distinguishes monitoring from control and traces sensor, controller, actuator and feedback roles through a closed-loop example.
Preserves the four required sensor types and application evidence while integrating them with the monitoring/control teaching sequence.
States the six gate symbols/functions, official input-count boundary and all required constructions among problem statements, expressions, circuits and truth tables.
